Fix the OOM in `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian/psi_cdindex_tree.v` by extracting the 39-line forall body (lines 223-261) into a standalone lemma.

Workspace: `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian`

## Root cause

In `has_left_child_psi` (line 111), the j=m case (line 183) calls `has_left_child_order_iso` with a 39-line forall body as the 4th argument. This body gets DUPLICATED at every recursive application of the IH inside `has_left_child_order_iso`, causing exponential proof term growth → 124GB OOM.

## The fix

Extract lines 223-261 into a standalone lemma. Currently:

```coq
apply: has_left_child_order_iso;
[ ... | ... | ... 
| move=> p q Hp Hq;
  (* 39 lines of proof *)
  exact: rank_shift_preserves_interior_order ... ].
```

After fix:

```coq
(* Proved ONCE, referenced by name *)
Lemma behead_rank_shift_order (s : seq nat) p q :
  uniq s -> 1 < size s ->
  (* ... appropriate hypotheses ... *)
  (nth 0 (behead s) p < nth 0 (behead s) q) =
  (nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq s)) p < nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq s)) q).

(* In has_left_child_psi: *)
apply: has_left_child_order_iso;
[ ... | ... | ...
| exact: behead_rank_shift_order ... ].
```

This changes the proof term from "39-line body duplicated N times" to "single reference duplicated N times" — exponentially smaller.

## Steps

1. Read lines 183-261 of psi_cdindex_tree.v carefully
2. Identify what hypotheses the forall body needs from the surrounding context
3. Formulate a standalone lemma with those hypotheses as parameters
4. Prove the lemma (the proof IS the current lines 223-261, just with explicit parameters)
5. Replace lines 223-261 with a call to the new lemma
6. Verify compilation: `opam exec -- coqc -vos -R . mathcomp_eulerian -w -notation-overridden -w -deprecated-library-file psi_cdindex_tree.v`

## Also check LR_pred_is_endpoint

Line 412-548 has a similar pattern. Check if it also passes large forall bodies to order_iso lemmas. If so, extract those too.

## Important

The forall body uses many local variables from the surrounding proof context (Huniq_dm, Hws_drop, Hhead_ext, etc.). The standalone lemma needs to take these as explicit parameters. Look at what `rank_shift_preserves_interior_order` needs and what the proof establishes.

Key lemma already exists in psi_comm.v:
```
rank_shift_preserves_interior_order : 
  uniq s -> 1 < size s -> ... ->
  (nth 0 s p < nth 0 s q) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq s) p < nth 0 (rank_shift_seq s) q)
```

The forall body essentially shows that `behead` preserves this property (shifting indices by 1). So the standalone lemma would be:

```coq
Lemma behead_rank_shift_order_iso s :
  uniq s -> 1 < size s ->
  (head 0 s == nth 0 (sort leq s) 0) || 
  (head 0 s == nth 0 (sort leq s) (size s).-1) ->
  forall p q, p < size (behead s) -> q < size (behead s) ->
  (nth 0 (behead s) p < nth 0 (behead s) q) =
  (nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq s)) p < nth 0 (behead (rank_shift_seq s)) q).
```

## Build test
```bash
opam exec -- coqc -vos -R . mathcomp_eulerian -w -notation-overridden -w -deprecated-library-file psi_cdindex_tree.v
```

## Constraints
- Zero Axiom, zero Admitted
- Must compile with -vos
- Do NOT break downstream files
